outputs.text: The $1,650 outreach system researched contacts and wrote outreach + follow-up; the client plugged copy into email/DM sequences. It did not send or run campaigns.
Price was “pretty random” off a $1,200 baseline; ROI math (2–3h × $50 ≈ $400/mo, ~4 months, ~$5k/year) is a later story, not how he priced.
First deals came from posting builds for fun with email in the description; he was not offering paid work.
After Milan/Tyler, they stopped guessing and sat with the client to break time/money cost, then priced so both sides saw an investment.
They charged $6,000 for Slack PA vs $4,000 for sales agent; in hindsight sales should have been higher because usage compounds with leads.
Closing over ~50% (later: way above 40–50%) means clients see a steal; B2B consulting strong is 20–30%; no friction → CLV too low.

Silent killers: underpricing (wrong clients, hard to raise later); saying yes to one more feature without rescope; chasing small retainers too early. One $10k project often beats five $2k/mo retainers. Stability = lead pipeline, not retainers.
True Horizon: one week internal QA (sample + real data, edge cases, fix before client sees) then one week client real-world QA + iterate.
On the $12k concierge they “transition[ed] the scope and architect to incorporate” MCP because it was a big deal online — a value lever: we stay bleeding edge.

outputs.text: Every sale is four moves: find the leak (time/money/focus), build the fix, translate to hours/$ /revenue, anchor price as a fraction of that value.
first deal predates the SOP.
Businesses care about three things; delivery vehicle (AI, VA, duct tape) is secondary.
he also sells flashy multi-agent YouTube because it performs.
Best-performing YouTube = flashy multi-agent; most practical / highest-ROI builds = some of his lowest-performing videos.
he still makes flashy videos.
On 5–10 “informational” calls, listen to the week, repeat the pattern, poke until hours/cost/errors/focus/trigger are numbered.
“no pitch unless you ask” vs later price step.
15 min draw flow → 60 min rough build on one platform → 15 min 3-min Loom (before / solution / result) with camera on.
Often you do not need a custom n8n agent; a platform or the CRM already does it. Do not multi-agent, five-vendor, or build a platform for Tuesday’s bottleneck.
YouTube still celebrates agents.
Cost the process (hours × wage × 4 × 12), take the automatable fraction, charge a fraction of yearly savings; write objective / in / out / timeline / client duties / payment or you underscope.
First three to five projects are paid practice. Either work free/cheap (system is theirs; optimize reps/proof) or offer money-back if value isn’t delivered. Then you can climb $1–2k → $30k+.
later tapes scold underpricing.
Ordered procedure from LEARNED §D — do not slogan-compress.
Situation: First $1,200 LinkedIn/content workflow, ~2 hours. Action: Pitched hours saved, not 15 nodes. Outcome: Paid; he calls $600/h the wrong frame.
Situation: Pedagogy onboarding. Action: 5h/week, 80%, $50/h, $10k/year, charge $3k. Outcome: “not a cost.”
Situation: LinkedIn outreach bot as product. Action: Reframe to qualified leads without ads. Outcome: “suddenly people see the value.”
Situation: Imposter, would have worked free. Action: Free/cheap or money-back for reps. Outcome: He claims $1–2k → $30k+ later.
IF the pitch names the tool (agent, chatbot, LinkedIn bot) → rewrite to T/M/F outcome.
IF a template bundle is the product → he says race to the bottom (learn; do not resell his).
IF niche fails repeat / pay-fast / language → pick another (hive: catalog only, no new id).
IF they describe a week → LRP until numbers exist.
IF Tuesday’s bottleneck fits CRM-native → do not custom-agent.
IF building >90 min for a POC → he says you drifted.
IF scope is vague → write the ten functionalities / definition of done (his underscope scar).
IF no proof yet → he chooses free/cheap or guarantee (hive: Evens only; else steal the proof artifacts only).

Stop selling agents (while his other titles sell agents). Lowest-view videos can be the money videos. Do not build custom n8n by default. Informational / no-pitch opener (then a priced solution). Free work as strategy vs `HNKlFTd1maM` raise-if-high-close — keep both. AI-OS and “regular automations” are explicitly not what he means by solutions.

seeded bugs vs “found a ton.”
